T-001.Title: Remove the historical mint test and retitle the depth guard

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: **Red control first, outside the suite.** Before any live edit, on a disposable non-Git copy of this tree, drive the measured two-part mint red control: with only the recursive `mkdir` mutation (`mkdirSync(bundlePath, { recursive: true })`), the retained real-CLI race test stays green because the shipped `flag: "wx"` exclusive spec write still refuses; with the recursive `mkdir` together with the non-exclusive `writeFileSync(candidate.specPath, candidate.expectedSpecBytes)`, the retained race test reddens. Restore the copy's bytes and observe green. The mutation is never committed to the suite and `src/grace-generate.test.ts` gains no planted-defect test. This criterion is `AC-ONE-TIME-RED-CONTROL`.

**Remove the permanent historical mint regression.** In `src/grace-generate.test.ts` remove the `BASE_COMMIT` constant (`6dd1d95`) and the test titled `AC-MINT-EXCLUSIVE: the isolated unmodified baseline overwrites the competitor (candidateSpecPreserved false)` including its `git worktree add --detach` block. Retain the interceptor describe, the race test `AC-MINT-EXCLUSIVE: the repaired tree refuses the interspersed competitor and preserves every byte`, the two exported-route tests (`mintResolvedBundle` and `mintBundle`), and the implicit-supersede test. Failure condition: any `6dd1d95`, `BASE_COMMIT`, or `worktree` occurrence remains; a retained test is removed. This criterion is `AC-HISTORICAL-MINT-CONTROL-REMOVED`.

**Retitle only the depth guard.** In `scripts/audit-regressions.test.ts` change only the depth test's title from `the validate job checks out full history for the pinned baseline control` to the approved exact title `the validate job checks out full history for the declaration-count coverage guard's historical base`. Preserve `validateJobCheckoutDepth`, its assertion body (`validateJobCheckoutDepth(xml)` equals `"0"`), `COVERAGE_BASE`, `declaredTests`, `coverageRegressions`, `collectTestFiles`, the `C-TEST-TIME-BUDGET-2-3EC1F016 coverage never falls` describe/test, and `validateCiRerunsSuite`. Failure condition: any of those symbols or tests is removed or the assertion body changes.

T-002.Title: Invalidate and regenerate the measured metrics artifact

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Invalidate the stale artifact explicitly (`rm -f test-metrics.json`) and run exactly one measured `bun run test:metrics`. The re-emitted `test-metrics.json` must name neither `AC-MINT-EXCLUSIVE: the isolated unmodified baseline overwrites the competitor (candidateSpecPreserved false)` nor `the validate job checks out full history for the pinned baseline control`, must name the new title `the validate job checks out full history for the declaration-count coverage guard's historical base`, must list every `.test.ts` under `src/` and `scripts/`, must have its `tests` count equal the sum of its per-file counts, and must contain no `(provisional)` entry. Report the measured test count; never project or pin it. Bare `test:metrics` on the fresh-looking artifact would leave the deleted and renamed names stale because `artifactIsStale` does not compare source test declarations, so the explicit invalidation is required.

Verification.Command: bun -e 'const m=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("test-metrics.json","utf8")); const names=new Set(m.tests.map(t=>t.name)); const oldMint="AC-MINT-EXCLUSIVE: the isolated unmodified baseline overwrites the competitor (candidateSpecPreserved false)"; const oldDepth="the validate job checks out full history for the pinned baseline control"; const newDepth="the validate job checks out full history for the declaration-count coverage guard's historical base"; if(names.has(oldMint))throw new Error("old mint name present"); if(names.has(oldDepth))throw new Error("old depth title present"); if(!names.has(newDepth))throw new Error("new depth title absent"); if([...names].some(n=>n==="(provisional)"))throw new Error("provisional entry present"); const fs=require("fs"),path=require("path"); const walk=(d,acc=[])=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d)){if(["node_modules",".git",".ngrace"].includes(e))continue; const f=path.join(d,e); if(fs.statSync(f).isDirectory())walk(f,acc); else if(e.endsWith(".test.ts"))acc.push(f.replaceAll(path.sep,"/"));} return acc;}; const declared=[...walk("src"),...walk("scripts")].sort(); const listed=m.files.map(f=>f.file).sort(); if(JSON.stringify(declared)!==JSON.stringify(listed))throw new Error("file list mismatch"); if(m.files.reduce((s,f)=>s+f.tests,0)!==m.tests.length)throw new Error("totals disagree"); console.log("metrics relation OK: "+m.tests.length+" tests across "+m.files.length+" files");'
